records.subject: Welcome aboard, Bright Media
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Bright Media* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no first project, no invites, no key milestone. Two Wrenfield emails (email:b12a7376, email:e998e0d6) went unanswered and no tickets filed, so there's no signal of engagement. Team plan and 8 days left leave some chance of self-serve activation, but silence makes it unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

I know the first week can get busy, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner. Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're bringing the Bright Media team along, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
